verdict.rationale: GitLab is documented as a Git-based platform covering source control, with docs for working with Git and for SSH keys and personal access tokens. Community reports of users pushing code confirm standard Git push works; slow pushes reported in one thread are a performance complaint, not evidence the capability fails. missing for 10: explicit docs on clone/pull/push over HTTPS and SSH, explicit statement that any standard Git client is supported, explicit link between personal access tokens and HTTPS Git authentication.
